current_decree_archive.retrieval: Official shell identifies lsiSeq290843 and effective20261001; its public ls.js identifies lsInfoR.do as the body endpoint. Full body retrieved and Article94 reviewed, not the empty wrapper or2025 English translation.
findings: Article94(1): eligible income-based foreign taxes exclude penalties and treaty-excess tax, subject to specified exceptions; Russia exception is outside current jurisdiction set.

Article94(2): Korean-law foreign income is reduced by corresponding direct and allocated expenses deducted in Korea but not already deducted in the source jurisdiction; special allocation election must continue five business years.

Article94(3)-(5): credit matches the income inclusion year; delayed foreign assessment or differing tax periods permit supplementary evidence within three months after foreign determination notice; later foreign tax adjustments follow the same provision.
Article94(6)-(7): loss/exempt-income/deduction allocations affect foreign income; separate limits by country.

Article94(15): excess associated with corresponding foreign-income expenses is excluded from ordinary carryforward and may be deducted in the following business year. Do not classify every unused foreign tax amount as ten-year carryforward.
current_decree_archive.remaining: Implement exact pre/post-expense country limits, eligible carry versus following-year deduction, expiry/ordering, then connect national/local saved workflows.

scope: Corporate foreign tax credits; existing korea_company.py covers ordinary domestic national/local settlement and does not establish foreign credit support.

reviewed_primary_source.locator: Article57, physical pages35-36; formula on page36 visually inspected
reviewed_primary_source.formula: Credit limit=A*B/C. A is calculated national corporate tax excluding specified land-transfer and investment/distribution-related separate taxes; B is foreign income reduced for relevant income-tax reduction/exemption proportion; C is the year's corporate income tax base.
findings: Paid or payable eligible foreign corporate tax is creditable within the limit.
Excess can carry into business years ending within10years from the following business-year start; expired unused tax may be deductible in the business year containing the day after expiry.
Article57(7) excludes dividends subject to Article18-4 income exclusion from paragraphs1-6 credit rules.
Tax-sparing and underlying dividend tax are distinct statutory routes with treaty/decree conditions; do not infer eligibility from direct tax payments.
